heading: Delhi schools receive bomb threats, searches underway
author: TOI City Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM /  Sep 21, 2026, 13:28 IST
paragraphs: NEW DELHI: Three schools in the national capital received bomb threats on Monday, prompting authorities to launch search operations, PTI reported.The schools include Mother International School in Hauz Khas, Navy Children’s School in Chanakyapuri and Bal Bharti School in Chanakyapuri, according to the Delhi Fire Services.“A search is underway, and nothing suspicious has been found so far,” an officer said.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Delhi | Silver Rate in Delhi | Bank Holidays in Delhi | Public Holidays in Delhi | Delhi AQI | Weather in Delhi | Petrol Price in Delhi | Diesel Price in Delhi | CNG Price in Delhi | LPG Price in DelhiStay updated with the latest Delhi news
